name: project_tool
description:
Discover, describe, and run source-scoped project-local tool manifests. Use this when a repository defines repeatable local workflows under `.nexa/tools/*.json` or `.agents/tools/*.json`, such as lint, test, codegen, diagnostics, export, or project-specific validation.

Prefer `list` first to discover available project tools, then `describe` to inspect parameters. Use `run` only when the project manifest clearly matches the task. Runs are command executions from local source manifests and require approval.

action.description: Use list to discover manifests, describe to inspect one manifest, or run to execute one manifest command.

name.description: Project tool name for describe or run.

arguments.description: JSON object of scalar argument values used to expand command arg placeholders such as {{path}}. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, or null.
